TextBlock.Text: THEATRE Eastern Banda corridor
DATE 20 November 2028 · 1340 local
SIDE Royal Australian Navy
WINDOW 75 min, closes at 112
SH-60K — JMSDF. Photo: Los688 · CC0 · cropped

EASTERN BANDA CORRIDOR. If STALWART's service window held on the sixteenth, your magazines were refilled; if not, you sail on what Southern Lifeline left you. The convoy has to cross a patrol box where a submarine and a surface threat overlap, and five weeks in, the Australian escort force cannot cover both.

MOGAMI and MAYA sail under Tokyo's orders, not ours, with an SH-60K and an SH-60J that are the best ASW pair in this sea. A Japanese F-2A pair forward at Langgur, in the Kai Islands, has one sortie today and it is loaded for ships: use it on the frigate coming in from the east, not on the fighters.

Two of the three priority merchants have to reach the handover, and CORAL PIONEER has to be one of them; lose her, or lose two, and the corridor is closed. The Type 039C is the real danger - she carries YJ-18 as well as torpedoes, and the four fighters coming down from the Biak enclave are her eyes as much as they are the reason you spend the day looking up instead of down. One of them is carrying something for a ship.
Commodore Alex Mercer
COMMANDER'S INTENT

Let the Japanese escorts hunt; that is what they are here for. The convoy is the cargo, the submarine is theirs, the frigate from the east is the F-2A pair's one sortie, and the fighters overhead are yours. Bring both Japanese ships home - the corridor still needs them after today.
• Two of the three priority merchants, Coral Pioneer among them, reach the handover point
• Keep the Japanese escorts in the fight
• Locate and classify the submarine

JS Mogami and JS Maya with an SH-60K and an SH-60J, one F-2A pair from Langgur, your escort group and the convoy. Opposing: a Type 039C, a Type 054A frigate from the east, a J-11BG, a J-11BS, a Su-27UBK and a J-10C off the Biak enclave field.

The planned window is 75 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 37 minutes more; the operation is closed at 112 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
